studies.title: Vanilla
studies.caption: Vanilla pods are the fruit of a climbing orchid. Growing the vine was only part of the work: flowers had to be pollinated before pods could form.
studies.prompt: Close botanical study of Vanilla planifolia climbing a shaded tree, thick green vine with aerial roots, fleshy elliptical leaves, one pale yellow-green orchid flower with recognizable tubular lip, several long slender green pods hanging from a separate mature cluster. No brown cured pods growing naturally, no bean tendrils or people.
